changelog: v3.27.3 stopped margin-era Bitfunded funding from being double-counted into challenges.funding_adjustment, but never routed it anywhere else -- Position History's own card PnL is gross of that same funding, which margin era nets out of Close Position's own returned amount before Bitfunded ever reports it, so net_pnl silently dropped it. A real ~$17.46 hole, caught immediately on a live re-import.

Fixed: for every margin-era trade, realised PnL is now read directly off the ledger (Close Position's own Amount plus the sum of its matched Open Position row(s) -- a same-symbol, same-exact-second group is multiple fills of one position and is summed, never picked), and net_pnl is computed from that instead of the card's gross PnL. Per-trade funding (card PnL minus that ledger figure) is stored on the trade exactly as before. trades.pnl itself is left untouched so re-import matching stays stable.

challenges.funding_adjustment is unaffected -- still only the counted (post-cutover) funding total from v3.27.3. Margin-era funding now lives inside net_pnl; zero-era funding lives in funding_adjustment; the two never overlap, and re-importing the same data twice is idempotent.

Import preview gained a 'Margin-era funding attributed to N trades' line. Trade Log table and trade detail panel both gained a Funding column/field -- trades.funding was written since v3.17.3 but never shown anywhere in the UI until now.

Zero-era trades are deliberately left as-is this release (card PnL vs. ledger's own Close Position amount, a smaller ~0.2 cent-rounding gap) -- judged lower priority than the real bug this release closes, not an oversight.
release_notes: No DB migration -- parsing logic (includes/bitfunded_parser.php), controller logic (includes/controllers/BitfundedImportController.php), and three small UI additions (js/bfimport.js, js/trades.js, pages/trades.php), no schema change. Self-test (php includes/bitfunded_parser.php) extended to 93 assertions: bf_reconcile_trade_funding() against the existing mixed-era fixture, a dedicated double-fill fixture modeled on the real ledger's own documented same-second-opens case, and a no-ledger-rows-found fallback case. Verified structurally against the real ledger (ledger-15min-entry.txt, 876 rows, not in this repo): the exact TRX figure already verified in v3.27.3/v3.17.3 (funding 2.6793) reproduces bit-for-bit; every one of the real ledger's 56 actual margin-era positions resolves to the margin branch through the real matching functions, not a hand-picked example. The full aggregate acceptance numbers from the briefing (margin-era funding ~-17.4617 across the real 120 Position History cards, final balance 9240.36) need Acrob's real card paste to confirm independently of the live re-import this release's own briefing already plans as the final check. php -l and node --check pass clean on every changed file; duplicate-name scan clean; full tools/ui-harness suite (13 drivers) passes.
